title: Carlos struggles to find the crash site in Moment of Contact

tellings.quote: And to me, if he were a liar, he would have said, "Here it is." But he gets there and he goes, "It wasn't here. In fact, the landscape has changed."

plain: In the 2022 documentary Moment of Contact, a witness named Carlos de Souza goes back to look for the spot near Varginha, Brazil, where he says a craft crashed, and he can't find it. Michels describes the scene, which also features James Fox: Carlos arrives and says "It wasn't here. In fact, the landscape has changed." Michels reads this as a sign of honesty, since he thinks a liar would simply have pointed and said "Here it is."
